Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know before you start watching anime.

Is the app really 100% free?
Yes! Anilab2 is completely free to use. We believe anime should be accessible to everyone. There are no subscription fees, no paywalls, and no credit card required.
Is it safe to install?
Absolutely. We prioritize user security. The APK file is scanned regularly for malware and viruses. We do not collect sensitive personal data from your device.
How do I install the APK?
Download the file from our homepage. Open the file and tap "Install". If prompted, allow installation from "Unknown Sources" in your Android settings.
Are there really no ads?
Unlike other "free" apps that interrupt you every few minutes, Anilab2 is designed to be completely ad-free for an uninterrupted anime viewing experience.
Do I need to create an account?
No login is required. You can download Anilab2 and start watching anime immediately. We do offer an optional login if you want to sync your watchlist across devices.
Is it available on the Play Store?
Currently, we distribute Anilab2 directly via our website to ensure we can offer all premium anime features for free without platform restrictions. Simply download the APK here to install.
